title: MISR Signature Register
constraints: 8-bit multiple-input signature register, polynomial x⁸ + x⁴ + x³ + x² + 1 (Galois form, feedback mask `8'h1D`).
On a rising edge with `en = 1`: `sig <= ({sig[6:0], 1'b0} ^ (sig[7] ? 8'h1D : 8'h00)) ^ din`. Without `en` it holds.
Synchronous reset sets `sig = 8'hFF`. `pass = (sig == golden)` is combinational. Must be synthesizable.
hints: It's an LFSR (shift left with polynomial feedback) whose state is also XORed with a new data word each cycle.
After N cycles, `sig` compresses N responses into 8 bits. A defect changes the signature with probability ≈ 1 − 2⁻⁸.
Seeding with all ones (not zero) makes an all-zero response stream still produce a non-trivial signature.
